digest.component_or_area: test design guidelines and convergence test patterns
propositions: Convergence tests that re-derive oracle behavior using the same helpers as the code under test remain green when the send path drifts, failing to catch the convergence bug they exist to prevent
The defective pattern (re-derived oracle) and sanctioned pattern (captured external effect) are syntactically identical, making automated detection unfeasible without unacceptable false positives

Test design guidance must be documented and discoverable to prevent authors from repeating the mistake of modeling external effects as recomposed helper calls rather than capturing real call-site output
The fix for the concrete defect already landed (commit 103729e90c); remaining work is to document the rule and sync it across four skill guidance documents
A mechanical lint check cannot distinguish re-derived oracles from legitimate characterization tests (those that intentionally call both helpers to verify contract equivalence) based on syntax alone
